items.meaning: One reviewable Definition Pack bound to the exact Goal, original intent, Context, consumer, source epoch, and authority ceiling.
items.absence_behavior: Do not hand off to Design or another consumer.

items.meaning: Exactly one current reuse, specialize, propose, or open disposition for every required concept, including the payload required by that disposition.
items.absence_behavior: Fail coverage and keep the omitted or incomplete concept visible.

items.meaning: Exact sources, evidence, provenance, meaning owners, decision owners, relations, and challenge or refresh routes remain attached.
items.absence_behavior: Treat the pack as incomplete and forbid hidden ownership or authority inference.

items.meaning: Unresolved questions, non-answers, conflicts, missing evidence, blocked uses, reasons, owners, and next actions remain visible.
items.absence_behavior: Block any handoff that would make unresolved meaning appear complete.

items.meaning: Candidate status, authority effect none, exclusions, allowed uses, blocked actions, and the next responsible owner remain explicit.
items.absence_behavior: Reject the output; never infer promotion, implementation, or execution authority.

owner_routes: Owner of the named intended use
challenge_route: Challenge pack shape through Definitions Governance, runtime production through the Define runtime owner, and suitability through the owner of the named intended use.
claim_limit: This contract defines Definition Pack completeness; it does not accept a pack, promote meaning, prove runtime persistence or interface parity, or authorize downstream work.
